description: [Data utilities] Work out a payment, delivery or legal deadline in business days for a given country. Use when a due date or notice period depends on local public holidays. Price: $0.002 per call (USDC on Base, x402). Returns the x402 payment requirements unless payment_signature is given. Sample: /samples/business-days

add.description: Business days to add (negative to subtract)

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value, relayed unchanged to the endpoint. Omit to receive the payment requirements.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD to count business days between

year.description: Year to list all public holidays

name: business_days
title: Public Holidays & Business Days (200+ countries) ($0.002)
